description: Closed assetRole enum derived from the real image slots in IMAGE_BRIEFS.md and ASSET_MANIFEST.md. reference-only roles may appear in reference-mode PageSpecs as evidence; blocked-for-generation roles must never be reproduced or fabricated; only generation-safe roles may appear in generated-mode PageSpecs.

globalGuidance.aiGeneration: A generator must never reproduce, trace, imitate or fabricate the source company logos, customer or investor wordmarks, third-party tool marks, certification seals, mascot artwork, product screenshots, people photographs, book covers, embedded endpoints or any other proprietary asset. In generated mode only the generation-safe roles are allowed and every media field must carry one of them.
globalGuidance.licensing: The source is a live commercial site. IMAGE_BRIEFS.md and ASSET_MANIFEST.md instruct: do not download, use, trace or recreate the original files. The commercial typefaces (Aeonik Fono, Aeonik Mono) are likewise not to be downloaded; free substitutes are listed in tokens/00-foundation/typography.json.
globalGuidance.cloneStandIns: The clone itself ships two kinds of stand-in media: original SVG artwork (src/components/ui/art, including the original mascot Pip) and 91 free-licensed stranger photographs (public/assets/photos, attribution in CREDITS.md and CREDITS.json: CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0, public domain, Unsplash). The photographs show real people; they are stand-ins for the portrait and team roles and must not be reused for generated pages. person-portrait and team-photo therefore stay blocked-for-generation.

roles.description: Wordmarks of real customers shown in logo strips, quote cards, case cards and comparison bars.
roles.aiGenerationGuidance: Never draw, trace, describe-and-render or otherwise reproduce a real company wordmark or logo. Use a placeholder wordmark box with invented text on an .example brand. Do not invent plausible customer names either.
roles.licensingGuidance: Real customer trademarks. The clone renders neutral placeholders; do not source the originals.

roles.licensingGuidance: Real firm trademarks; never reproduce or imply endorsement.

roles.description: Third-party tool, language, agent, cloud and project marks (tool tiles, ecosystem partners, integration arc, repo cards, agent tabs).
roles.aiGenerationGuidance: Never draw, trace, describe-and-render or otherwise reproduce a real company wordmark or logo. Use a placeholder wordmark box with invented text on an .example brand. Agent-client and language marks are third-party trademarks.
roles.licensingGuidance: Third-party trademarks (ASSET_MANIFEST: use neutral glyphs). Do not redraw them.

roles.description: Audit and certification seals in the footer.
roles.aiGenerationGuidance: Never fabricate a certification seal; a generated page may only show an obviously generic placeholder badge.
roles.licensingGuidance: Certification marks are issued by third parties; showing one without certification is misleading.

roles.description: The source brand wordmark and duck mark (header, footer, comparison table, final CTA, logo marks).
roles.aiGenerationGuidance: Never reproduce the source logo or any look-alike. In generated mode use a text wordmark for the fictional brand.
roles.licensingGuidance: Source brand trademark. The clone itself uses a same-size placeholder SVG.

roles.description: The source company's duck mascot artwork and poses (hero art, section illustrations, FAQ and form decorations, animated character).
roles.aiGenerationGuidance: Never reproduce, trace or imitate the source mascot or its poses. The clone replaces it with its own original character; generated pages use a new fictional mascot.
roles.licensingGuidance: Source copyrighted character art; not reusable under any mode other than the original owner.

roles.description: Pip, the clone's own original mascot (a rounded data-block body with an antenna and stubby legs) that stands in for the source mascot in reference mode.
roles.aiGenerationGuidance: Pip is original to the clone. It may appear in reference-mode reconstructions; generated pages should use a new fictional mascot instead so they do not look like a copy of this site.
roles.licensingGuidance: Original art made for this clone; no third-party rights, but not intended as the generated-page default.
